text:
samantha: Quick sync after the postmortem — we identified three recurring patterns (cache warmup thrash, model-variant flaps, and routing hot spots). Need concrete owners, runbook commands, and timelines. Can we lock owners today?
ira: I can take model-variant flaps. I'll add a short rollback checklist and the exact admin API calls. ETA EOD.
mike: I'll own cache warmup fixes, and add a small prime script + perf test steps.
oliver: I'll update the triage runbook with minimal commands and add an escalation matrix.
ops-bot: Reminder: add tasks to INF-3201 (postmortem follow-ups) — use subtasks for each owner.
samantha: For runbook changes, keep the triage checklist to 4 steps max so paging happens fast. Also include kubectl and curl one-liners we used.
ira: Draft for rollback command:
```
# swap to a lower-capacity variant with zero-downtime
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/models/swap-variant \
  -d '{"service":"inference","from":"v2","to":"v1-fallback"}'
```
ira: Rollback criteria: error_rate <= baseline + 0.5% and p99_latency < 1.2s for 10m continuous. Service owner signs off.
mike: cache prime example:
```
# prime top prefixes from yesterday's sample
python tools/prime_prefixes.py --input s3://prod-telemetry/top-prefixes-2025-06-06.txt --concurrency 4
```
mike: test plan: run prime in staging, run 10m traffic replay, verify hit_rate > 80% and latency p99 < 700ms.
oliver: triage runbook snippet to pin:
1) Confirm alarm: grafana -> inference/errors (p95/p99)
2) Check routing table: curl -s https://infra.internal/routing?env=prod
3) KV cache hit: curl -s https://cache-metrics.internal/stats | jq .hit_rate
4) If hit_rate < 60% -> run prime script or scale cache-layer

samantha: Add kubectl quick checks too:
```
# view recent pod events and restarts
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide --sort-by=.status.startTime
kubectl -n prod describe pod <pod-name> | sed -n '1,120p'
```
ira: escalation thresholds proposal: page infra when error_rate > 4% for 3m OR p99 > 2s for 5m. For anything customer-affecting -> page legal + support after incident declared.
mike: noted recurring pattern "cache warmup thrash" during traffic spikes. Action: add metric warmup_phase boolean + automated prime on spike detection. I'll add instrumentation tickets.
oliver: I'll add a small flowchart and a one-page summary for new oncall. Also will pin the commands in the runbook card.
samantha: Ownership and timelines: INF-3202 (model-variant runbook) -> ira -> due 2025-06-10, INF-3203 (cache warmup) -> mike -> due 2025-06-12, INF-3204 (triage runbook + escalation matrix) -> oliver -> due 2025-06-09. Weekly check-ins until closed.
ops-bot: Tasks created and linked: INF-3202, INF-3203, INF-3204. Weekly reminder set (Wednesdays 15:00 UTC).
ira: I'll include the exact admin API responses to expect (success/error codes) so runbook is unambiguous.
mike: I'll produce a small canary checklist and staging playbook to validate changes before prod rollout.
oliver: after I post the updated runbook I'll ping #oncall with highlights. Also embedding the flowchart in the runbook card.
samantha: Great. We'll reconvene in 48h to review PRs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
